newsitem.title: USA: Family Golf buy could hurt EPS - analyst.
newsitem.headline: Family Golf buy could hurt EPS - analyst.

text.p: Family Golf Center's purchase of Leisure Complexes Inc, announced late Thursday, could nick earnings by a few cents a share in 1997 but should add to earnings in 1998, according to Advest analyst Bret Jordan.

-- In a research report, he said the deal could shave 1998 earnings by $0.02 to $0.03 in 1997, but said he would refine his estimate when the company files its 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission within the next two weeks.
-- Family Golf made the announcement simultaneously with the release of its second quarter earnings of $0.34, $0.03 above Jordan's estimate. It earned $0.18 a share in the same period last year.
-- He cited higher-than-expected pro shop sales, strong retail margins and corporate cost controls.
-- Stock is rated a buy with a price target of $34.
-- Shares were up 1/8 to 24-7/8 in early trading.
